title: SelectionMovedParams
description: The reported selection moved on screen because the page scrolled or the viewport resized. At most once per animation frame, and only between a report with a rect (selectionChanged, or contextMenuOpened) and selectionCleared.

devicePixelRatio.description: The page's window.devicePixelRatio, which includes page zoom.

occluded.description: Whether other elements, such as a sticky header, cover all of the selected text that's in the viewport. False when the selection is out of the viewport, which the rect shows.
